title: TypeError: stepModel.doStream is not a function

linked_prs.title: fix(package/ai): bind functions for v2 -> v3 adapter
linked_prs.body:
## Background

Current implementation of v2 -> v3 adapters doesn't bind the functions properly and just changes the specification version, leading to an error seen in #9093 

## Summary

explicitly bind the functions for each respective models

## Manual Verification

Verified the bug goes away by small reproduction of the error in `examples/repro-issue-9093` after this change

## Checklist

- [x] Tests have been added / updated (for bug fixes / features)
- [ ] Documentation has been added / updated (for bug fixes / features)
- [x] A _patch_ changeset for relevant packages has been added (for bug fixes / features - run `pnpm changeset` in the project root)
- [x] Formatting issues have been fixed (run `pnpm prettier-fix` in the project root)

## Related Issues

Fixes #9093

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.

Explanation: The issue involves agent instantiation with an LLM provider (Anthropic), model configuration, and streaming output. The error occurs during agent streaming, likely due to incompatibility or misconfiguration between the agent and the LLM provider/model, fitting the "Incompatibility with LLM providers" agent issue category.
